title: fix(app-shell): the validation preview names a state machine's empty target as May be cleared
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5S6gNFvmKHxrqpXWgottKg)_
Fixes #36734

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 管理员在 Studio 元数据管理里预览状态机校验规则时,"可清空"的状态以前显示成结尾多一根竖线或一整行空白,现在明确写出"可清空"(中英文都有)。
- 替 Studio 状态机规则编辑解决:规则面板已能勾选"可清空",预览却把它画成坏行或空行。
- 只影响预览显示,规则的保存与执行不变;出错最多是预览文字不对,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `ValidationPreview` (state_machine branch): a `''` target is no longer joined as a state name. Named targets still render joined by ` | `; when `''` is present a muted marker reads **May be cleared** (zh-CN **可清空**). A row whose only target is `''` shows only the marker; an empty list still reads as the dead-end text.
- The marker reuses the existing catalogue row `engine.studio.rules.transitionClearable` (the Studio rules panel's checkbox label for the same `''` target), so no catalogue entry was added.
- Patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ValidationPreview.tsx`, the state_machine `entries.map` hunk (the only behaviour change).
2. `ValidationPreview.test.tsx`, its last top-level `describe` (the objectstack#36734 pin).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ValidationPreview.test.tsx` — expect 17 passed, two of them the en-US and zh-CN clearable-target cases.

## Tests
- New pin (one top-level `describe` in the existing `ValidationPreview.test.tsx` harness file, per ruling record 6583487846) renders `transitions: { paused: ['open', ''], closed: [''], archived: [] }` in en-US and zh-CN and asserts every row: `paused` = `open` + the marker, `closed` = the marker alone, `archived` = the dead-end text.
- Ablation: with the original render restored on disk, both cases go red (`paused: 'open | '`, `closed: ''`); restored from HEAD, green.

- `vitest run` of `ValidationPreview.test.tsx` + `dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 71 passed (71); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation on f80c352a (original render on disk): Tests 2 failed, 15 passed (17); the two failures are the en-US and zh-CN pin cases, received `paused: 'open | '`, `closed: ''`.

Earlier readings (head 15ad181f, before the fold):

- `vitest run` of the pin + `ValidationPreview.test.tsx` + `dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3.test.tsx`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 71 passed (71); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation run: Tests 2 failed (2), the expected/received diff above.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (after building its dependency closure): lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (taken on 799f1501, before the main merge).
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 38 derived commands plus `check:changeset-fixed`, all exit 0 on 799f1501; `--ran` reconciliation 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- The pin lives in the existing `ValidationPreview.test.tsx` as one top-level `describe` (root AGENTS.md, ruling record 6583487846); the separate pin file of the first push was folded in and deleted.
- The first head (15ad181f) shows red `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check` and `Test UI`: each is an aggregator reporting lanes that concluded `cancelled`, because the fold push superseded that run (PR concurrency cancel-in-progress). No test or gate failed there.
